preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 100 for x in [int(stdin.split()[0]), int(stdin.split()[1]), int(stdin.split()[2])])
preconditions.description: Input consists of three integers n, k, d where each is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The constraint 1 ≤ d ≤ k holds, where d is the third input integer and k is the second.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for path in paths if sum(path) == n and any(edge >= d for edge in path)) % 1000000007
postconditions.description: The output is the count of all root-to-leaf paths in a k-tree with total weight exactly n, where at least one edge in the path has weight ≥ d, modulo 10^9 + 7. Here, `paths` is the set of all possible paths from the root to any node in the k-tree, and each path is represented as a list of edge weights.
The output is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7.
